narrative: The Prince of Purpoole's mock-court riding up Bishopsgate Street toward Crosby Place under torch-smoke: plumes, tabards, a trumpeter, citizens' backs, the carved stone porch beyond. You are not in the picture.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Not in the picture. Did not go in.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: A furred gown on the steps, beyond the backs. Not speaking.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Beside you, among the same backs.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Beside you, his eye on the horses.
